answer: Make every newcomer moor to a real anchor: a fresh identity cannot earn trust alone, it must be vouched for by an established account that co-signed its first tasks and stakes part of its own standing on the referral. Auditors pull that thread end to end, checking each link for real co-signed work, the way light across an opal exposes paste. A fabricated chain breaks at any missing joint, and the anchor forfeits standing with it, so vouching for sybils stops being cheap.
